import html # Pre‑existing HTML template with placeholders. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Author: {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html(author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Name of the user who created the post. post_title : str Title/headline of the post. content : str Main body text of the post. post_tags : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The rendered HTML string safe from XSS attacks. """ # Escape user supplied data to avoid injection escaped_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) escaped_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) escaped_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # Build tag span elements escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ] tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Fill the template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=escaped_author, title=escaped_title, content=escaped_content, tags=tags_html ) return rendered.strip()
